dc11d_preview.interpretation: HTTP 200 is a GoDaddy/parking lander (JS redirect to /lander), not Vercel attach. Gate text wants 200 OR 301-to-Vercel (domain attached). Status 200 holds; attach does not. DNS fix is out of scope this lane.

notTarget: MCP tool calls (property-atom-chain and siblings fan to retrieval)
design.incidental: GET /health dependency probes hit engine /healthz and cortex /api/healthz. Dep cache TTL 15s (hauska-mcp-server/src/health.ts DEP_CACHE_TTL_MS). Health ramps therefore fan downstream at most once per 15s per instance, not at request RPS.
design.whyInitialize: POST /mcp initialize is behind authMiddleware (rate limiter) and does not call retrieval/cortex. It is the limiter seam. GET /health is registered before auth and is not rate-limited — used for latency + postgres-primary proof.

phases.budget: HAUSKA_FREE_IP_RPM default 60, 60-second fixed window; HAUSKA_FREE_IP_DAILY default 1000
phases.note: Tiers run back-to-back in one rpm window so cumulative 200s prove the 60 cap. Total initialize ~420, under daily 1000.

design.healthSampling: GET /health at phase/tier boundaries plus every 5s during ramps. Record rate_limit_store.{state,primary,memory_fallback,detail,latency_ms}.

expectedBands.countingRule: n = requests the harness actually fired in that tier. 200_rate = count(status==200)/n. 429_rate = count(status==429)/n. Percentiles computed on ALL completed responses (including 429), plus a second p50/p95/p99 on status==200 only. A result outside a band is a finding either way.

mcp_init_1rps_20s.note: Fresh rpm window expected; 20 < 60 so 429s here would mean the window was already warm or daily exhausted.

mcp_init_5rps_20s.note: Cumulative with prior 20 ≈ 120 in one window. 429s MUST appear. 200s in this tier expected roughly remaining rpm (~40 if window started at tier 1).

announce.cortexNeon: limiter writes rate_limit_counters on MCP DATABASE_URL only; no atoms table access

constraints: No atoms slot / no --apply / no heavy scan
No cortex-api or retrieval-api load fan beyond incidental /health deps
No hauska-mcp-server code change this lane
contractVsDispatch: NO DISAGREEMENT. Slot law honored (no --apply). Heavy-scan serialization N/A (no PostGIS scan). Verification at source (gcloud + live /health) before load.
